description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Adds people to a customer_list audience (audienceId from ads_audiences_list or ads_audience_create): users is a list of { email?, phone? }, phones with the country code. Values are normalised and deduplicated; already-hashed SHA-256 values pass through; rows without a valid email or phone are skipped and counted. At most the configured batch size per call. flayr never stores the people sent; the audit keeps counts and a digest. Only upload people the brand has consent to advertise to. Pass agentName and reason. Audited in Ads > Agent activity. Guardrails: flayr enforces the owner's agent ceiling (per month, per campaign, per day) on the server; you cannot raise it. Inside it the change is applied at once; above it nothing changes and the result is `approval_requested` (HTTP 202) with `approvalId` and `approvalUrl`, the owner's one-click approval link: give it to the user (an owner can also decide approvalId with approvals_decide, through a different connection). When the owner set approvals to API/MCP/chat only (`assistantOnly: true`) there is no link: tell the user to approve approvalId with approvals_decide or in flayr chat. Either way, repeat the exact same call once the owner approves (the approval covers that call once). Every call is audited (Ads > Agent activity) and the owner gets a daily digest. Pass agentName and reason; both are shown to the owner.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/audiences/{audienceId}/users.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

name: ads_audience_users_add
title: Upload a customer list
